note: Caribou-Targhee NF campground in Teton Canyon beside Teton Creek, in Wyoming but reached only from Driggs, ID (about 11 mi: Ski Hill Rd, Alta Rd, then gravel Teton Canyon Rd). Trailheads to Alaska Basin and Table Mountain (Jedediah Smith Wilderness) start at the campground. Run by a concessionaire; no host. --Claude
summary: FS r04 page + recreation.gov 231928: 13 gravel sites 20-60 ft (005/016 FCFS 20-ft pull-throughs) plus 2 equestrian sites, $17 2026-2028, $8 extra vehicle, water, vault toilets, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 4-day booking cutoff. Pin 79 m from the site centroid - OK. Not waterfront kept (creek under forest).
flags: Season conflict: recreation.gov season May 21 - Sep 5 2027 (May 22 - Sep 6 2026) vs FS page 'Mid-June-Early September' - recreation.gov written; the 2026 calendar for past months could not be read (the API refuses past dates).
Rig length: stored max_rig_ft 40 (FS page 'RVs up to 40 feet') -> 60 from the catalog's longest site (002, 018: 60 ft). Reviewer may prefer the FS 40.

Horse sites: the FS page lists 'two equestrian sites' beside the 13 single sites; they are not in the recreation.gov catalog and their location is not given. A horse transfer facility (trailhead) is nearby. Flag only - two horse sites in a general campground, not a horse camp.
Minimum stay: 2 nights on weekends, 3 on holiday weekends (recreation.gov rules) - not a standing minimum.
Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: Teton Creek is not visible under the forest canopy south/east of the loops on Esri imagery; no site is tagged waterfront in the catalog.
Phone: empty -> 541-351-1182 (FS page contact 'Audi Campground Services'; recreation.gov 'please call (541) 351-1182'); district office Teton Basin RD (208) 354-2312.
